Definition: from G1062; to espouse (a daughter to a husband):--give in marriage.
BiblicalUsage: Gamisko means to give in marriage, to espouse a daughter to a husband. It appears once, in Luke 20:34, where Jesus says the children of this world marry and are given in marriage. The word belongs to this age, and Jesus sets it against the age to come, where they neither marry nor are given in marriage.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus draws a clear line between this world and the next; marriage belongs to this age, and the resurrection belongs to the age where death is no more; I hold that the love we know now is a shadow of the love that waits.
